reason: Original Games page incorrectly used source-projected strict provider-resolved_count, which was 0 for every game, and read only UE5 source-unknown package summaries, ignoring existing indexed IoStore and global ScriptObjects target identities.

definition.resolved_references: Current total dependency references MINUS current unresolved references, including common and package-only outcomes
definition.resolved_files: Files with >=1 source dependency and no unresolved or source-confirmed missing references; a single file counted at most once
definition.unresolved_files: Distinct files with >=1 reference that is still unresolved; for Zen this is after exact catalogue target lookup
definition.unresolved_ue5: Exact required target identities not yet matched to the currently indexed ready/published IoStore content and global.utoc ScriptObjects. This is not a source-confirmed missing or mounted-engine runtime failure.
definition.source_parity: Original UEDB5 source policy, dependency edges and native loader outcomes retained without mutation. Website catalogue coverage is a distinct read-only metric.

verified_ue5.conclusion: Cannot assert the remaining 26 missing-from-index IDs are missing from Satisfactory itself; other not-yet-imported UE5/base-game content may contain them. No native mount-order resolution is inferred.

tests.real_PRD_source_mode: Read-only MySQL transactions and actual DEV PHP GET requests against source-selected PRD metadata

caveats: Previously published source strict-resolved_count=0 expresses unknown native provider mount, not catalogue target coverage.
For UE5 with missing base-game packages, the 244 references are unverified in the imported dataset, not necessarily missing from a runnable installation.
The global.utoc is a companion ScriptObjects source, not a member of the 27,240 FactoryGame packages.
UE5 Games-page catalogue coverage is not a substitute for native UE5 loader/PackageStore mount verification.
UE5 mixed classic+Zen games conservatively withhold aggregate reference totals until a supported complete current-game index is available.
